messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — ACME Legal asked for our completed SIG/CAIQ and a redline of the DPA with SCCs. They're also pushing for confirmation on DSAR/data deletion flow and whether we can show an audit trail for deletion requests.

jason_sec: I can own the SIG/CAIQ answers. Quick Q — do we have a canned CAIQ export for Dedicated/Private vs Hosted? They want specifics around key management, logging, and tenant isolation.

alan_se: We do. There's a dedicated sheet for 'deployment modes' in RG-SEC-templates. I'll paste later. Also ACME asked if Dedicated includes HSM integration or just KMS. Any comms from infra?

beth_engineering: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS; HSM is available in Private on-prem option. Can confirm with infra team tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

zoe_privacy: For DPA + SCCs we should offer the redline but flag the DSAR timing. Standard commitment: respond to DSAR within 30 days; deletion of user content executed within X days depending on retention policy. Need to sync on retention matrix for logs vs model artifacts.

maria_sales: They want an explicit statement: "we delete customer-provided prompt data within 90 days and purge derived analytics after 180 days" — can we commit to that?

jason_sec: We can't promise 90/180 without confirming telemetry retention. Off the cuff: customer data at rest (S3) can be lifecycle'd for immediate purge on termination. Telemetry/metrics are aggregated and retained 90 days by default. I'll validate.

alan_se: Pricing question from their infra lead: if they move to Dedicated with reserved capacity, is there a price delta for data residency/extra logging? short answer: yes, enterprise add-on for Private/VPC and extended log retention. @maria_sales I'll need their expected QPS to firm numbers.

maria_sales: I'll ask for QPS and number of regions. Also ACME wants a copy of our deletion audit log sample. Is there a sanitized example we can share?

beth_engineering: We can share a redacted deletion audit export (CSV) — includes request id, user id hash, deletion timestamp, and actor. I'll prepare a template. Format:
```
request_id,user_hash,actor,action,timestamp,object_type
req_123,hash(abcd),system,delete,2026-02-12T15:24:00Z,prompt
```

zoe_privacy: That example is fine. For the DPA redline I'll add a clause clarifying DSAR timelines and their right to request deletion plus our migration window. Also propose an SLA for certs and KMS key rotations.

jason_sec: For CAIQ: I'll mark controls as 'pooled' vs 'dedicated' per deployment and call out where compensating controls exist. Any open items: MFA enforcement for service accounts (we enforce on console), and key lifecycle policy (rotation every 90 days by default).

maria_sales: Action items: Jason — CAIQ answers + redacted audit CSV (ETA EOD Thu). Zoe — DPA redline w/ DSAR clause (ETA Fri). Beth — confirm HSM availability for Private (ETA Fri). Alan — draft cost delta based on QPS once I have numbers.

deploy-bot: Note: schedule created — "ACME SIG review" on 2026-03-25 10:00 UTC. Invite: #sales-acme + jason_sec + zoe_privacy + beth_engineering

alan_se: I'll prep the POC architecture diagram and include recommended quantization/latency profiles that affect cost.

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll reply to ACME with timelines and attach the CAIQ + redline next week. Thanks all :pray:

zoe_privacy: One more: include language in the email about processors/subprocessors list and link to our subprocessors page: https://redwood.ai/legal/subprocessors

maria_sales: noted. Sending initial reply now — will CC legal and sec.
